exposure: TOLAC delivery bundle (education for healthcare providers, TOLAC discussion sheet, patient educational tools)
outcome: rates of trial of labour after caesarean delivery
cohort: Obstetrical patients with a singleton gestation in cephalic presentation and one previous caesarean delivery were included.
finding: The implemented TOLAC bundle significantly decreased caesarean delivery rates without negatively impacting uterine rupture or neonatal intensive care admission rates.
mod_finding: The TOLAC bundle reduced caesarean delivery rates, indicating a shift in the mode of birth towards vaginal birth after caesarean, without increasing adverse outcomes like uterine rupture.
